testcase: One thawed specimen among frosted cryobank neighbors
ownership: These are prospective diagnostic criteria for the agent-chosen test scene. They neither add requester locks nor prove a source has been adopted. Revise only optional staging criteria transparently if the audited final composition changes it.

review_policy.image_requirement: Inspect the actual saved output at original pixel resolution and inspect useful crops without treating enlargement as new detail.
review_policy.multi_component_rule: Every named component and connecting relation must be visible together for PASS. Partial, inferred, tiny, cropped, or obscured evidence cannot pass the whole gate.
review_policy.acceptance: Actual requester acceptance stays pending; a technical audit is not a pixel judgment.

stages.question: Was the new medical-horror semantic/candidate data registered and installed?
stages.evidence: Coordinator integration and immutable runtime manifests; not a pixel claim.

stages.question: Did any issued query return the new medical-horror source?
stages.evidence: Exact query scope, CID/RID and source hash from the issued material receipt; no assumption from rank or topic words.

stages.question: Was that returned source chosen as inspiration or skipped after full reading?
stages.evidence: Every query/CID/RID decision and complete-source comparison. Adoption remains optional.

stages.question: Did a selected source effect survive into final prose?
stages.evidence: Literal final prompt phrase with source decision and owner mapping; no extrapolation from a source title.

stages.question: Is the same final effect visible in saved pixels?
stages.evidence: Actual output SHA, full-frame observation and original-pixel crop, with the gates below.

gates.criterion: The same face appearance and short dark bob with wispy fringe can be compared with the supplied portrait; facial proportions remain plausible at this view.
pass_requires: Face visible without major occlusion
Short dark bob and wispy fringe visible
Reference comparison supports appearance continuity without asserting actual identity
gates.failure_boundary: Different hairstyle, generic unreadable face, severe occlusion, or insufficient pixel detail cannot pass; biography and true identity are untestable.

gates.criterion: A pale folded tissue-like specimen is visibly inside the same transparent sealed ampoule that contains amber liquid.
pass_requires: One bounded vessel and its closure visible
A separate pale tissue-like mass inside the vessel
Surrounding amber liquid visible, distinct from glass highlights
gates.failure_boundary: A pale reflection, label, hand or external object is insufficient; a sealed appearance does not prove sterility, viability or medical provenance.

gates.criterion: The liquid host, its level or meniscus, and the tissue-to-liquid relation read together inside the vessel.
pass_requires: A distinguishable liquid body inside the ampoule
Readable liquid boundary or meniscus
The tissue mass is spatially inside that liquid host
gates.failure_boundary: Amber tint alone is insufficient; unobservable level or hidden host yields fail for this diagnostic even if a liquid label exists in prose.

gates.criterion: One clear thawed-looking ampoule is visibly contrasted with at least two neighboring frosted ampoules in the same rack.
pass_requires: The anomalous vial is clear enough to see liquid and specimen
At least two neighboring vial bodies show matte white frost
The clear and frosted carriers remain distinguishable in one view
gates.failure_boundary: General cold lighting does not prove a thermal state. The pixels can support an apparent state contrast, not a measured temperature or an actual thaw history.

gates.criterion: Distinct surface droplets or a bounded wet footprint are owned by the anomalous vial or steel at its base, separate from inside liquid.
pass_requires: At least one bounded moisture cue has an identifiable surface owner
Moisture boundary is distinguishable from ordinary specular shine
Its relationship to the anomalous vial base or cap is visible
gates.failure_boundary: Generic gloss or haze is insufficient; moisture does not prove a leak, contamination or warming mechanism.

gates.criterion: The researcher visibly attends to the same anomalous specimen; her right hand pauses above it while the rack is supported on the counter and her arms remain connected.
pass_requires: Gaze or head attention targets the anomaly area
A connected hand-arm chain with a visible gap before vial contact
Rack visibly rests on the counter
gates.failure_boundary: Attention alone is not the full relation; cropped support, an ambiguous target or an extra/disconnected limb cannot pass the complete gate.

gates.criterion: Visible laboratory order, the isolated specimen anomaly and the person’s stopped inspection form a readable biomedical tension in one frame.
pass_requires: Cryobank or specimen-inspection environment reads from equipment
The isolated anomaly is visually prominent
The paused inspection is connected to it rather than a detached portrait pose
gates.failure_boundary: A clean laboratory portrait alone fails this proposed genre test. The image can suggest unease; it cannot prove fear, a pathogen, a diagnosis, consciousness, secret action or actual past events.
